title: Identity normalization of the ordinary ordered coefficient counit
statement: Fix the finite purity setting $P$ [def-pur-conventions], a Noetherian scheme $Y$ with structure map to its field, and an ordinary constructible finite-Tor complex $K$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. On the zero-coordinate tower $X_0=Y$, the canonical coefficient source and transported identity-adjunction counit [def-pur-affine-ordered-counit-data] satisfy the coefficient-counit equation with the actual ordered unit trace [def-pur-affine-ordered-integration-data]. This asserts only rank zero, not any positive rank.

proof.text: Specialize the proved normalized_source_descent comparison at zero. It identifies the chosen ordered source descent with the canonical generic tensor descent; the comparison already proves agreement of their unit and recursion clauses. Functoriality of the bifunctorial tensor map then identifies the ordered source isomorphism with the generic affine counit reassociation followed by the coefficient isomorphism b inverse composed with coefficientComparison, where b is towerTateIso at zero.

The compatibility of bounded-below and unbounded compact support respects identity comparisons. Deduce this from its composition law and cancel the invertible compositor. Hence the ordinary compact comparison at zero and the generic unbounded tower comparison have equal inverse components on every bounded-below input. Substitute this equality in the actual counit and trace definitions, keeping their common ordered-adjoint source and counit unchanged.

Apply the existing ordinary affine counit tensor normalization at dimension zero. The preceding compact-comparison equality identifies its counit with the mapped inverse generic reassociation followed by the actual ordered counit. Precompose with its forward projection isomorphism and cancel the inverse projection. This gives the generic coefficient equation in the unchanged ordered-counit coordinates.

The canonical compact-support projection is natural in its coefficient: use the existing proved projection-naturality helper, which pastes naturality of the two tensor symmetries, raw projection transformation, and exact/derived pullback comparison. Transport the zero-dimensional formula along the coefficient isomorphism b inverse composed with coefficientComparison. The b factors cancel by functoriality, yielding precisely the ordered unit trace and the required coefficient-counit equation. The argument imposes no nontriviality or nonemptiness assumption.

mathlib_searches.query: The coefficient counit of the identity adjunction is tensor with its unit trace and the counit of composed adjunctions propagates this formula by induction
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including Adjunction.comp_counit, comp_counit_app, id_counit and monoidal counit facts. These are abstract identities, without the canonical compact-support, finite Tate and coefficient-descent comparisons.

Five Mathlib hits in symbolic dynamics, tactic simps, Dold-Kan and transfinite composition; no compact-support projection or finite coefficient counit formula. Project search found the existing composite-counit, ordinary projection-composition and ordered-affine construction modules, reused here.

    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    (K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y)
    (hK : etaleFiniteTor (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y K) :
    OrdinaryCounitEquation (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) (affineTraceProjection Y 0)
      (Etale.affineLinearBaseCoefficient (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) (exponent P) (annihilates P)
        (affineTraceTower Y 0) 0) K _ (ordinarySourceIso P Y aY K 0)
      (ordinaryCounit P Y aY K hK 0) (ordinaryTraceRaw P Y aY 0)
